name: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd
summary: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and commercialization of circular forged components. A key area of their expertise also encompasses advanced ring forgings for the aerospace industry. These high-performance parts are indispensable across a wide array of demanding sectors, such as aviation, shipbuilding, high-speed rail transport, nuclear energy, the broader space exploration field, and heavy construction machinery. The company, which was founded in 2006, has its main operations located in Guiyang, China.
